messages:
Priya Nair: Quick follow-up from the DB failover postmortem — we need clear owners for the remediation items, JIRA tickets for each action, RACI for rollout, and a handoff plan into the sprint. Who can take which?
Miguel Santos: I can own updating the failover runbook + the DR test plan. Will open a JIRA and link it here (INF-5229?). ETA end of sprint (2 weeks).
Samir Patel: I’ll take the autoscaler tuning action and add the monitoring dashboards. Will create ticket OPS-3135 and tag @Priya for review.
Ingrid Holm: I can handle the incident alerting thresholds and dedupe rules (SRE). I need access to the alert rules board — pinging @Lina for perms.
Lina (ProductOps): @Ingrid granted cluster-alerts write. Also we should RACI the user-notification step — ProductOps should be consulted for messaging cadence.
Priya Nair: Thanks. For clarity, let's do RACI like this: Miguel (R/A) runbook, Samir (R/A) autoscaler, Ingrid (R/A) alerts, Lina (C) product comms, Priya (I) final sign-off. OK?
Miguel Santos: ok from me.
Samir Patel: fine.
Ingrid Holm: agree.
Priya Nair: On timelines: Miguel + Samir 2 weeks, Ingrid 1 week for alerts, Lina will draft comms when notified. If any blockers, escalate here.
Miguel Santos: Opening INF-5229 now -> https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-5229 (runbook + playbook tasks).
Samir Patel: OPS-3135 created -> https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/OPS-3135 (autoscaler tuning, dashboard work).
Ingrid Holm: ALERT-204 created -> https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ALERT-204 (thresholds + dedupe).
Priya Nair: Nice. Let's add a two-week checkpoint: set recurring reminder to check progress and test DR run. @DevOps Bot can you schedule a reminder for 2026-04-05 10:00AM PT?
DevOps Bot: Reminder scheduled: "PM remediation checkpoint: INF-5229, OPS-3135, ALERT-204" on 2026-04-05 10:00AM PT.
Lina (ProductOps): I'll draft the customer-facing messaging template and attach it to INF-5229 once Miguel's runbook draft is ready.
Samir Patel: Noted one recurring pattern we spotted: scaling lag on medium traffic ramps. I logged it as a cause in OPS-3135. We should consider adding a synthetic load test in staging to catch regressions.
Priya Nair: Good call. Add a subtask for synthetic load test in OPS-3135 and assign to Samir.
Samir Patel: Done. Added OPS-3135-1 (staging synthetic test).
Ingrid Holm: Also proposing a monthly DR drill to surface other recurring patterns — if we all agree I'll put a recurring event on the calendar.
Miguel Santos: +1 for monthly drills.
Priya Nair: Agreed. Lina, can ProductOps coordinate the calendar invite?
Lina (ProductOps): Yep — will create a recurring invite and include SRE/Infra/Prod.
Priya Nair: Final ask: after tickets are created, please update the remediation tracker spreadsheet (link shared in the PM). I'll do a final pass next Friday.
Miguel Santos: Will update tracker when INF-5229 has the first draft.
Samir Patel: Will update when OPS-3135 has dashboard PR.
Ingrid Holm: I'll post ALERT-204 runbook snippets once thresholds are live.
Priya Nair: Great. Thanks everyone. Closing the thread — keep updates in the JIRAs and the tracker. :thumbsup:
